# pi-glance 0.7.1

- Show compatible plugins' status text in the top line. Extensions can be toggled, reordered and inspected; empty groups stay hidden, and built-in facts keep priority.
- Choose from nine theme-matched Working sweep color options. Theme default keeps the previous appearance.
- Preview settings at full input width, below a stable settings area. The panel works in regular and fullscreen modes without replacing the editor or resetting the prompt cursor.
- Keep the existing settings navigation and save/cancel behavior. Refresh the screenshots and simplify overlapping display tests.
- Requires Pi 0.85.0 or newer; Pi 0.85.1 is recommended. Node.js 22.19.0 remains the minimum.
